context: A mom and son chat about activities
purpose: Teach: 柔軟性/それだけに/試す/ディフェンス/冠/ビジュアル/レコーディング/引き分け

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、体育で、体の柔軟性、ほめられたんだよ、ぼく!
lines.en: Mom—at PE today, the teacher said I was really flexible!
lines.style: Bright, quick energy on the opening. Words tumble out—he's been holding this in. Slight lift at the end, seeking approval. The pride is genuine but young, still checking if it matters.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: うん。優しい翔くん、それだけに、ママ、嬉しいの、いつも。
lines.en: I know, sweetheart. That makes me happy—the way you notice things about yourself with such kindness.
lines.style: Warm, attentive exhale. Slow enough to let the words land. She's not praising the flexibility; she's noticing him noticing himself. Gentle, maternal, the kind of attention that makes a child feel seen.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: 新しい味、ぼく、試すの、好きだよ、勇気あるでしょ?
lines.en: And I tried that new food at lunch—the one I wasn't sure about. That took courage, right?
lines.style: Quick, seeking energy returns. He's building his case. Small enthusiasm—not loud, but insistent. Slightly uncertain at the end, waiting for confirmation that this counts too.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: お兄ちゃん、サッカーで、ディフェンス、やってたわよね、覚えてる?
lines.en: You know, your brother was the same way with soccer—remember when he was playing defense?
lines.style: Gentle redirect. She's not dismissing; she's connecting him to something larger. Warm, slightly distant—she's remembering. The pace is unhurried, like she's pulling up an old, fond detail.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お祭りで、王冠みたいな帽子、被ったよ、楽しかった!
lines.en: Oh! And at the festival, I wore that crown-shaped hat. It was so much fun!
lines.style: Bright, uncontained excitement. The memory lands fresh. Short, bouncing energy—he's jumping between moments, each one bright. Pure, uncomplicated joy in the recollection.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 動画の中、ビジュアル、すごく綺麗だわね、これ。
lines.en: The visuals in that video we watched were so beautiful, weren't they?
lines.style: Soft, almost conversational. She's noticing something small and lovely. Not directed at him now—more to herself, gently inclusive. The pace is slow, meditative. She lingers on the image.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: お父さん、若い頃、レコーディングスタジオ、行ったことあるって。
lines.en: Your dad mentioned once that he went to a recording studio when he was younger.
lines.style: Thoughtful, curious tone. Not interrogative—more wondering aloud. She's piecing something together, or simply following his thread of interest. The pace is easy, inviting him to wonder with her.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 今日のサッカー、引き分けだったわね、惜しかったわ。
lines.en: Today's soccer match ended in a tie, didn't it? So close.
lines.style: Quiet, knowing tone. The words settle softly. There's understanding in the near-miss—she's not dismissing the disappointment, just acknowledging it with simple presence. Trailing off slightly, like she's sitting with him in it.
